backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minted tokens with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, hooks, and styles for the NFT art portfolio app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, loading the React app via Vite's module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that sets up TanStack Router with all routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Error banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing the error message and a retry button that reloads the page.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks with German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Admin list component displaying all NFT collections with edit (dialog) and delete (alert dialog) actions, showing skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: A form component for creating and editing NFT items, handling image upload with preview, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Displays a list of all NFTs in the admin panel with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and delete/edit actions including a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: A card component that renders a single legacy artwork with its image, title, and description using a hover scale/overlay effect.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: A small badge component that displays the current backend connectivity status (loading, online, or unreachable) using the health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Displays a minted on-chain NFT card with image, token ID, mint date, owner address, and optional 'Mein NFT' badge for owned tokens.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout wrapping pages with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), actor error banner, main content area, and footer with backend status indicator.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A dialog modal for minting a new NFT on ICP, supporting drag-and-drop image upload, title/description input, upload progress display, and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Renders the main navigation bar with route links, conditionally shows an Admin link only after backend confirms admin status, and displays a retry button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A simple badge component displaying a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label used to mark NFT items.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: Renders a single NFT item as a card with image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer external link, supporting click/keyboard interaction.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: Displays an NFT collection as a clickable card linking to its Getgems marketplace page, showing an image with loading/error states, title, description, and a trade call-to-action.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: Renders a static grid section of seven predefined NFT collections (with names, descriptions, image paths, and Getgems trade URLs) using NFTCollectionCard components.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A dialog modal that shows detailed NFT information (image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price) with copyable fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture for educational context on the platform.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: Displays metadata for a single NFT item including its ICRC-7 token ID, mint date, price in ICP, and a link to the ICP Explorer.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays a (optionally shortened) Internet Computer principal with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of hardcoded blog posts about light wavelengths and eye health.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the Internet Identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Exposes a boolean indicating whether the backend actor is fully initialized, and sets an error state if initialization stalls beyond 20 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: Performs a periodic lightweight health check against the backend by calling getAllCollections, returning query status for use in a status indicator component.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook that always throws an error indicating blog creation is unavailable, as the old blog backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend to create a new NFT collection and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT to the backend and returns the created NFT item, with auth error parsing and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID and invalidates both collections and NFT item queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID and invalidates the NFT items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, allowing static blog posts to display while the old blog backend is no longer used.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, combining actor loading state with query loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via the backend's listAllNFTs method, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch since the artwork backend was removed.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-filtered artwork fetch.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null for a single blog post, deferring to static posts since the blog backend was removed.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, enabled only when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's issued NFTs via the actor's `listMyNFTs` method, with loading state derived from actor and identity initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID using the actor's `getNFT` method, enabled only when the actor is ready and an ID is provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection via the actor's `getNFTsByCollection` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that calls the backend `isCallerAdmin` method to check if the authenticated user has admin permissions, enabled only when the actor and identity are ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Admin-check hook with a phase-based state machine and configurable timeout, supporting a hardcoded fallback principal and a retry mechanism to handle slow or failing backend calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the actor, parses auth-related errors into user-friendly German messages, and invalidates relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the actor and invalidates the `currentUserProfile` query on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates a collection's name and description via the actor and invalidates the `nft-collections` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the actor and invalidates the `nft-items` query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Custom hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading to the backend via the actor, returning the resulting `ExternalBlob`.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines a warm OKLCH-based design token palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with a timeout, showing loading/error/access-denied states, and renders tabbed forms and lists for managing NFT collections and individual NFTs.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards with dates, and shows a 'New Post' button for authenticated admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only blog post creation page with a form for title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins back to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post detail page that resolves a post by ID from either static data or the backend, displaying its title, date, featured image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with fields for name, email, subject, and message, including client-side validation and success/error feedback via the useSubmitContactForm hook.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page featuring a hero banner, an inspirational quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation component, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching NFT and collection data by ID from URL params and displaying image, metadata, price, and on-chain explorer link with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page showing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login state management using tabbed layout.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page allowing authenticated users to create a new NFT by filling out a form with title, description, price, collection, and image file, with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended font families, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for accordion and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the Istvan Seidel NFT Gallery project, including known issues (admin access denial, missing contract address display) and pending feature requests for UI refinements, navigation renaming, and admin/contract address fixes.
